# Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

We want MacClair to be a place where anyone can contribute — whether you write Swift,
translate a string, or report a bug in your second language. We pledge to make participation
harassment-free for everyone, regardless of age, body size, visible or invisible disability,
ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender identity and expression, level of experience,
education, socio-economic status, nationality, personal appearance, race, religion, or sexual
identity and orientation.

## Expected behaviour

- Be kind and assume good faith. Most "obvious mistakes" are a missing piece of context.
- Critique the code, not the person. "This could panic on a symlink" beats "this is sloppy".
- Accept that the maintainer decides the scope: MacClair is a small, focused tool and saying no
  to a feature is not a judgement on your work.
- Respect privacy. Never paste another person's file names, paths, screenshots or logs into an
  issue without their consent — the app works on personal data by design.

## Unacceptable behaviour

- Insults, personal or political attacks, trolling, dismissive comments about someone's level.
- Sexualised language or imagery, and unwelcome sexual attention.
- Public or private harassment, doxxing, publishing someone's private information.
- Sustained disruption of discussions, or reopening a settled decision to wear people down.

## Scope

This applies in the repository (issues, pull requests, discussions, commit messages, code
comments) and anywhere someone is representing the project.

## Enforcement

Report a problem to **najmabdi777@gmail.com**. Reports are read by the maintainer only and are
handled confidentially. Expect an answer within 7 days.

Consequences escalate with the behaviour: a private warning and a request to edit or delete the
comment; then a temporary ban from interaction; then a permanent ban from the project. The
maintainer may remove, edit or reject contributions that break these rules, and will say why.

## Attribution

Adapted from the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org), version 2.1.
